products.name: Helixon
products.summary: A premium biotech ecommerce platform built around transparency, verification, and modern commerce architecture — lot verification, certificate transparency, and QR validation as first-class product features rather than compliance afterthoughts.
highlights: Custom commerce engine — cart, checkout, orders, promotions, refunds
Event-sourced inventory with lot and batch traceability
COA transparency and QR lot verification
Canonical QR routing so packaging never needs reprinting
Operational admin designed as a first-class product

timeline.event: Domain model, commerce engine, and storefront
Inventory ledger, lot and batch traceability, COA platform

products.name: Project Atlas
products.tagline: The next product is already in motion.
products.summary: An AI-native platform designed to help businesses recover receivables, automate follow-up, and improve cash flow without replacing the accounting systems they already use. The final product name has not yet been announced.
highlights: Recovers outstanding invoices rather than only issuing them
Automates follow-up after an invoice is sent
Understands how customers respond, not just whether they paid
Improves payment velocity as the measured outcome
Augments existing accounting systems instead of replacing them

products.name: TrustLaunch
products.summary: Helping businesses launch, measure, and grow customer trust through reviews, reputation, AI insights, verification, and trust intelligence. A trust layer for a business, not another review inbox.
highlights: Review collection and request workflows
Reputation dashboard and trust score
AI reputation assistant and sentiment analysis
Embeddable trust widgets and QR feedback
Verification and reputation analytics

timeline.event: Trust score and AI reputation assistant

products.name: Opsly
products.tagline: A business operating system, not another CRM
products.summary: A modular, AI-powered operating system helping businesses automate operations, customer engagement, and growth. Businesses enable only the engines they need, on a shared architecture, identity, and operational foundation.
highlights: Composable engines rather than one monolithic CRM
Multi-tenant from the domain model up
Lead capture, scheduling, and workflow automation
AI assistants applied at decision points, not everywhere
Integrates with existing software rather than replacing it

timeline.event: Lead capture and workflow automation engines

products.name: Clue Finder Tours
products.tagline: Turning physical locations into programmable experiences
products.summary: Self-guided scavenger-hunt tours that turn a city into a playable experience. The hard part is not rendering content — it is modelling progression: where a player is, what they have unlocked, and what happens when they solve the next clue.
highlights: Three product surfaces: tours web app, mobile app, and admin
Hunt engine separating authored content from player state
Checkpoint, clue, and progression architecture
Stripe purchase and access model

timeline.event: Tours web application and hunt engine
Mobile app, PWA, and admin authoring

products.name: PlainText
products.tagline: Writing without the software getting in the way
products.summary: An AI-assisted writing platform built end to end — frontend, backend, UX, and LLM integration — on the premise that most writing tools spend the user's attention on the tool rather than the writing.
highlights: Built end to end: frontend, backend, and UX
LLM integration for AI-assisted drafting
Founded and developed solo

timeline.event: Built end to end as sole founder
